phases.title: Reprodukovatelný baseline a delta audit
phases.note: QUAL-001 and the v18 production baseline are recorded; v19 live rollout is separate.

phases.title: SDK v2, schema versions a kompatibilní adapter
phases.note: Contracts, compatibility fixtures, CLI clean-room and runtime registry pass locally; publication is GATE-DIST-001.

phases.title: AppShell a surface state machine
phases.note: The complete shell composition is live in r11: independent centred command/utility rails, exact phone/tablet breakpoints, desktop resizing, mobile snaps and Visual Viewport keyboard handling pass. Remaining phase-2 gaps are the broad component-library and per-flow UI quality requirements.

phases.title: Taxonomie vrstev, podkladů a footer surfaces
phases.note: The r12 Layers/Basemaps redesign and r13 recovery behavior are live. Draw failures now visibly fall back while restoring overlays, and bike recommendations preserve the manual background. The remaining phase-3 delta is real partner entitlement acceptance for the optional partner source.

phases.title: PostGIS, viewport query budget a TaskRegistry
phases.note: The r16 global task center is live with a footer/safe-area-aware compact summary, separate concurrent entries, typed progress and capability-aware cancel/retry/error actions. Complete critical-flow registration, independent POI/detail/route/weather/AI local states and the production PostGIS SLO remain open.

phases.title: Search intent router, suggestions a map picker
phases.note: The complete search slice is live in r13: working geocoder requests with grounded metadata, explicit ordinary-search versus AI choice, confirmable layer commands, scoped AI candidates, map-picker round-trip, working-pin preview and editable suggested-plan creation.

phases.title: Personal v2 a saved-place doména
phases.note: The r15 Personal redesign is live with owner-only counts and lists, closed card accordions, compact plan actions, deterministic saved-place search/categories, distinct category pins and global-search separation. The remaining phase-6 delta is PER-022: distinct owned, staked and favourite game-locality relations with their permissions.

phases.title: PlanDocument v2 a skutečný segmentový routing
phases.note: The full planning slice passes: manual and large-plan editing, denied-GPS fallback, fixed-center picking, bounded transport batches, segmented routing, exports, external handoffs, durable sharing, scoped AI, bike-map recommendation, alternatives, deterministic adventure scoring, selectable continuous map segments and dated weather/traffic context with explicit no-data states.

phases.title: AI Gateway, tools, command diff a scoped conversations
phases.note: Safe gateway/diff/scopes, the seven-domain tool registry, deterministic nearest POI and bounded conversation compaction pass offline; remaining user-facing AI use cases stay open.

phases.title: Discover v2 a regionální kontextová pipeline
phases.note: The r24 Discover slice is complete and live: privacy-safe first run and denied-GPS handling, viewport-bounded region selection, generic sourced statistics, use-case-aware summaries, independently registered context capabilities and the visible sourced contribution review workflow all have automated and runtime evidence.

phases.title: Weather jako adaptivní vrstva a jediný TimelineHost
phases.note: The r23 weather slice is live: one adaptive field transitions from a regional colour map to bounded cells and local numeric sectors, hover/tap share one detail card, and visualization/zoom changes preserve the same map, source and base style. The r17 daily forecast accordion remains covered by its earlier live record.

phases.title: Canonical events a roční event timeline
phases.note: The r18 annual Events experience is live with a nonlinear twelve-month timeline, responsive Discover explorer, synchronized filters, sourced detail/actions and explicit unknown-price handling. Cited AI event enrichment and a geography/time-feasible festival route remain absent.

phases.title: POI detail, media, social a provider actions
phases.note: Core offline slice passes; moderation/reporting, synced private notes and ingest worker remain gated.

phases.title: User/partner Layer SDK, import/export a dokumentace
phases.note: Offline clean-room/import flow and cross-instance durable preview repository pass; public distribution and live PostgreSQL smoke remain open.

phases.title: Linked identity, SIWE a wallet inventory
phases.note: EOA SIWE/simulation pass; EIP-1271 and confirmed official live Base inventory remain external gates.

phases.title: Commerce, entitlements, subscriptions, referrals a tips
phases.note: Provider-neutral ledger passes; real provider/catalogue/use-case evidence is required.

phases.title: True 3D Aavegotchi vertical slice a mobilní hra
phases.note: Neutral 3D/controller slice passes; the actual model payload and physical-device performance evidence are gated.

phases.title: Security, observability, load a release hardening
phases.note: Offline hardening passes; final suite, v19 deployment, off-host backup/PITR and live restore remain pending.

phases.title: Open-source release, telemetry-gated cleanup a další aplikace
phases.note: Local clean-room runtime passes; public npm/docs/signing and adoption-gated cleanup remain external/ADR gates.

gates.missing: Add and exercise a chain-aware EIP-1271 verifier; EOA SIWE already passes offline.

gates.missing: Configure a real provider, signed webhook transport, catalogue/use-case and provider-owned staging evidence. Synthetic production checkout remains forbidden.

gates.missing: Obtain an actual model payload, produce an optimized GLB/LOD report and capture supported physical-device frame/memory evidence.

gates.title: Official live Base inventory indexer
gates.missing: Confirm an official primary inventory source/indexer and exercise it with SIWE without inferring holdings.

gates.title: Realtime aircraft/ship provider and adapter

gates.title: Administrative boundary dataset and pipeline

gates.title: Durable horizontal preview store
